_comment: Cookie Run BOX-FARM run-grind, EPISODE 6 (Plum Blossom Palace) — plays runs to the end (till death) collecting Mystery Boxes passively; no early quit. PRECONDITION: Episode 6 selected on home BEFORE starting (bot only taps Play!). BOOST: +17% base speed Random Boost equipped every run (probe_speed checks the speedbase17_banner pill; buy_speed taps the pink Multi toggle 1649,337 -> picker with +17% base speed PRE-TICKED -> Multi-Buy 953,899 -> auto-roll). Fast Start prompt tapped at run start (faststart_btn tap_template + faststart_check). Cookie Relay Boost tap (960,540) once per 4-hop cycle. Boxes collected mid-run are opened on the Mystery Box screen after Result. Loop: home->Play->await_shop->probe_speed->buy_speed->start_run->check_heart->Play->await_faststart->faststart_check->run(J->J->S->J till death)->run_result->mystery_box->reveal->home. QUIT-AFTER-2: check_box/quit_run (ported from boxrun_ep3) bail the run early via the pause menu once a Mystery Box is collected, but ONLY on the 2nd run-with-a-box this session — a Python-level counter (see tools/run_boxrun_ep4.py) tracks that across runs since the static FSM has no per-run variables; earlier box runs play to natural death.

home._note: Main menu, detected by the episode-independent 'Play!' button (home_play_marker.png — see coinrun.json for why the old Episode-banner marker silently broke). Play! visible = nothing covers it, tap it. Absent -> a modal covers it or we're elsewhere: hand off to probe_sendlife (NEVER blind-tap from here). 3000ms wait covers the boost-shop fade-in before await_shop re-checks. Play! at (1650,970). Play! at (1650,970) -> await_shop. No home-spam and no after_play gate: after_play misread the Play! button showing THROUGH the shop fade (~0.87) as a missed tap and double-tapped Play, which closed the shop. Fast Start is spammed later (await_shop absent = direct run, or check_heart = shop path) — always AFTER we have left home, so it can never hit the leaderboard.

await_shop._note: After Play, poll for the boost shop. It settles to 1.00 within ~1s WHEN Play was tapped on a stable home; if home was still fading the tap can miss, so retry 6x/700ms. Shop present -> probe_speed. Absent after retries = direct run (boost still equipped, no shop) -> spam the Fast Start spot (985,515) across the prompt window (safe now: we are off home) -> running.

probe_dailycheckin._note: New head of the modal-peeling chain. The 'Daily Check-in' calendar pops ONCE per day at first launch and sits ON TOP of home, hiding Play! — with no dismiss the whole bot stalls here (observed live: run loop never resumed). Detected by the unique 'Daily Check-in' banner title (dailycheckin_marker: self=1.000, in-run frame=0.232 — no false-positive). Present -> tap the green OK button (965,985, CV-located from the button's green blob) -> home re-checks. Absent -> fall to probe_sendlife, the rest of the chain unchanged.

probe_treasurereward._note: The 'Power+ Treasure Rewards' popup stacks right after Daily Check-in at launch (Choco Dip Sticks / Crystal Crown etc.), also covering Play!. Same stall class as the check-in: no dismiss -> bot loses home. Detected by the unique 'Power+ Treasure Rewards' title (marker self=1.000, in-run=0.31, vs dailycheckin=0.40 — no cross-match). Present -> tap Confirm (960,850) -> home. Absent -> fall to probe_sendlife. Reached from BOTH the check-in dismiss (popups queue) and directly when only this one shows.

probe_sendlife._note: Reached whenever Play! is not visible and no Daily Check-in popup was on screen. 'Send <friend> a free Life?' dialog pops over home when a stray tap lands on a leaderboard friend row. Tap Cancel (727,688 — gray, left); NEVER Confirm (1189,687). Detected by the unique 'Gift Points' text. Dismissed -> home. Absent -> try the boost shop next.

boost_shop._note: Boost shop open (entry point for guard/probe re-routing). Route to probe_speed to ensure +17% base speed is equipped before Play.

picker._note: 'Pick desired Boosts!' popup. +17% base speed stays PRE-TICKED — DO NOT tap any row (each toggles). Tap Multi-Buy ONCE — game AUTO-ROLLS, spending coins, until +17% base speed lands, then stops. Hand to wait_roll. ABSENT -> picker never opened -> settle-retry then retry_buy.

wait_roll._note: The self-rolling Multi-Buy is in progress: the game keeps re-rolling and spending coins until +17% base speed lands, showing a Stop button (rollstop_marker, self=1.000; settled/Play frame=0.37) the whole time. Do NOTHING — no taps — just self-loop while the Stop button is present so we never cut the roll short. The ep3 multibuy_marker did NOT match ep6 roll UI, so wait_roll exited instantly, start_run read a still-rolling (speed-absent) banner, and the loop re-bought forever. Stop gone -> roll finished -> read the banner in start_run. absent (Stop gone) is a goto to a DIFFERENT state (start_run) so the self-loop + timeout is safe.

check_boost_result._note: Auto-roll finished, picker closed back to the boost shop. Check 'Not enough Coins!' first (balance ran dry mid-roll) -> cancel. Otherwise read the pill in start_run. We do NOT re-roll here — the game rolled to completion.

insufficient_coins._note: SAFETY: 'Not enough Coins!' popup. Tap Cancel (770,685) — NEVER Confirm (1150,685), which spends gems. Then Play! with whatever boost we have (or none).

force_play._note: Coins exhausted — stop chasing the speed boost, Play! with whatever we have. Still route through check_heart so we don't run on empty hearts.

start_run._note: SPEED ENFORCEMENT: reached only AFTER wait_roll confirmed the roll UI is gone. Pill present -> the roll landed +17% base speed -> check_heart -> Play. Pill ABSENT -> the roll never landed it (or the picker never opened) -> retry_buy, which buys again until we do. The only sanctioned Play-without-+17% base speed path is the nocoins escape (insufficient_coins -> force_play). RETRY GRACE (4x800ms): after Multi-Buy the roll animation + banner render take ~2-3s; checking instantly read a still-fading banner (0.6) and looped back into buy_speed, re-rolling and burning coins. Same class of fix as probe_speed.

retry_buy._note: Re-buy gate: we ended up without the +17% speed boost and must roll again. Check the wallet FIRST so we never spin on an empty balance: 'Not enough Coins!' up -> insufficient_coins (Cancel, then force_play — the ONLY sanctioned Play-without-speed path). No popup -> coins remain, loop back into buy_speed. Termination is natural (each roll drains coins until the game raises nocoins); a genuinely stuck loop trips the engine's 100-poll livelock warning.

check_heart._note: SINGLE Play gate. heart_empty present -> wait 30s self-loop until a heart regenerates. Absent (>=1 heart) -> tap Play, then SPAM-TAP the Fast Start button spot (985,515) every ~400ms from the load screen through the whole prompt window and into the run. Blind spam instead of detect+tap: the prompt appears ~5.6s after Play and lingers only ~2s, so a fixed cadence of taps across 0-8s can never miss it, and taps that land before/after the prompt are harmless (empty run area). Ends at running.

running._note: In-run (auto-play). Result popup up -> run over. Not up -> we MIGHT still be running, but could equally be on home or in the shop, so DON'T tap yet: hand off to the guard chain.

guard_not_home._note: Guard 1/2 before any in-run tap: Play! on screen -> we're on home, not running.

guard_not_shop._note: Guard 2/2: in the boost shop -> resume via boost_shop. Neither Play! nor shop visible -> guard_not_sendlife (rule out a Send-Life/Level-Up popup before assuming genuinely mid-run and jumping blind).

guard_not_sendlife._note: Guard 3: a "Send <name> a free Life?" dialog can pop mid-loop when a stray tap grazes a leaderboard friend row (we are actually still on the Friends-tab home, not mid-run). Detect it and Cancel (727,688 — gray/left, NEVER Confirm) -> home. Absent -> guard_not_levelup. Ported from boxrun_ep5.

guard_not_levelup._note: Guard 4: a "Level Up" reward popup (levelup_marker, self=1.000) can pop mid-loop from auto-play XP gain — same class as Send-Life. Confirm (959,969, same coord as probe_levelup) -> home. Absent -> genuinely mid-run -> resume the original jump/relay action (moved here from guard_not_shop) and hand to jump_2. Ported from boxrun_ep5.

jump_2._note: Hop 2/4 — jump. One capture per hop, spent on the only mid-run question: result popup up? If not, jump again. RELAY REVERTED: (490,955) was misread from a partner-count BADGE, not the actual relay button. The Cookie Relay Boost tap is screen-centre (960,540) as originally verified — restored here.

jump_3._note: Hop 3/4 — the SLIDE hop of the J->J->S->J anti-collision cycle. Overhead bars are the one obstacle class a jump can never clear; one slide per 4-hop cycle (~every 3-4s) sweeps them without giving up much pit coverage. Slide zone = the 'Slide' button bottom-right (~1671,937), press-and-hold via act.py (default ~550ms clears a typical low bar). Same detect contract: result up -> run over. RELAY REVERTED: (490,955) was misread from a partner-count BADGE, not the actual relay button. The Cookie Relay Boost tap is screen-centre (960,540) as originally verified — restored here.

jump_4._note: Hop 4/4 — jump, last hop before a housekeeping pass through the probe chain (popups don't expire on their own; sweeping every ~4 hops clears them at a quarter of the capture cost). RELAY REVERTED: (490,955) was misread from a partner-count BADGE, not the actual relay button. The Cookie Relay Boost tap is screen-centre (960,540) as originally verified — restored here.

check_shop_after_run._note: Result popup not up yet — still running, home is back, or we're in the shop. Try home; absent -> walk the probe chain.

probe_boostshop._note: Recovery probe: sitting in the boost shop (process started there, or run ended straight into shop)? boost_shop routes to probe_speed.

probe_congrats._note: Level-up 'Congratulations!' popup (free reward). Confirm (956,846) is safe/free.

probe_levelup._note: Separate 'Level Up' popup (gems/coins/score-bonus, distinct from the Congratulations ticket popup). Confirm (959,969) is safe/free.

probe_rankingrewards._note: SAFETY NET: gold 'Ranking Rewards' season popup opened by a stray leaderboard tap. X at (1672,135), free/safe.

probe_giftdraw._note: SAFETY NET: 'Gift Draw' popup over home. Tap X (1685,170) — never Draw; the farm loop must not auto-consume gift draws.

probe_friendinfo._note: SAFETY NET: 'Friend's ___' popup family (can stack 2 layers). Tap inner X (1552,117) then outer X (1633,107) each pass, self-loop until the ribbon is gone.

run_result._note: Result popup after a run. Tap OK (702,940) — NOT 'Show Off'. After OK the Mystery Box screen appears on runs that collected a '?' box — the whole point of this bot — handled by mystery_box.

mystery_box._note: After Result-OK we either land on home, or the 'Mystery Box' screen blocks it. Detect the BOX screen positively. Present -> tap the closed box (960,540) and read the reward. Absent -> home (or a modal; home's probe chain handles it).

mystery_box_reveal._note: Reward reveal can show MULTIPLE ingredients — one Confirm tap only advances to the next item. Self-loop: keep tapping Confirm (959,960) while the 'Mystery Box' title is still up; fall through to mystery_box_recheck once it's gone.

mystery_box_recheck._note: After collecting the box: Play! visible -> home is clear, continue the loop. Not visible -> something still covers it; go through probe_sendlife, never blind-tap.

probe_inactive._note: Home-side inactive guard. 'You've been inactive for a while. The game will restart!' can queue on/over home after a long idle. Confirm (953,690) lets the restart proceed, then hand to recover_login to re-auth. Absent -> probe_prevresults.

probe_prevresults._note: 'Previous Results / You have unreviewed game results' pops after a run that was cut short (e.g. by the inactive-restart). Confirm (950,680) opens the Result screen, then fall through to the normal chain which peels Result/MysteryBox/Congrats. Absent -> probe_dailycheckin (chain unchanged).

guard_not_inactive._note: Mid-run inactive guard. The inactive-restart popup can fire WHILE a run is on screen (Jump/Slide visible) when the bot stops feeding input -> observed live hanging the run. Confirm (953,690) -> recover_login re-auths. Absent -> the run is genuinely live: fall through to the original mid-run action (unchanged). RELAY REVERTED: (490,955) was misread from a partner-count BADGE, not the actual relay button. The Cookie Relay Boost tap is screen-centre (960,540) as originally verified — restored here.

recover_login._note: Login recovery step 1 (DevPlay title). After the inactive-restart the game reopens on the DevPlay title with the orange 'DevPlay Login' button (devplaylogin_marker, self=1.0). Present -> tap it (960,950) to open the account picker, wait for the fade, hand to recover_pick. Absent -> we may already be at the picker (or past login) -> recover_pick.

verify_no_popup._note: Play-tap gate. The 'You've been inactive -> restart' popup overlays home/shop while Play! still scores ~0.87 through it, so home.on_match would tap Play INTO the popup and spin. Check inactive_marker first: present -> Confirm (953,690) -> recover_login re-auths. Absent -> no popup, run the real Play tap (original home.on_match body).

recover_pick._note: Login recovery step 2 (account picker). login_marker = 'You already have an account!' + CookieRun logo (name-agnostic). Present -> tap the top saved account row (1100,490), wait out the ~12s login + home load, re-enter start_state (home). Absent -> the picker isn't up (login already completed, or the title is still animating) -> go to start_state and let its own detection settle; if we're still on the title, home will be absent and the probe chain loops us back to recover_login.

mb_gate._note: Mystery Box screen has (at least) two layouts: a single 'Open all' button (960,965) that opens every box at once, and an older tap-the-box-directly layout (960,540) for a lone/first box. Tapping only one coord could miss the other layout and leave mysterybox_marker matching forever (timeout only fires on the ABSENT path, so a match that never changes has no built-in escape) -> observed live hanging on this screen. Tap BOTH every pass: Open-all first, then box-center, each with its own settle wait, before re-checking via mystery_box_reveal. Harmless if one coord hits nothing.

mb_reveal_gate._note: Reveal retry chain step 1/6 (escape hatch). Dual-tap Open-all(960,965) + Confirm(959,960), then hand to retry_2 rather than looping straight back to mystery_box_reveal forever — bounds the whole reveal loop to 6 passes max.

mb_reveal_retry_2._note: Reveal retry chain (escape hatch): mysterybox_marker can theoretically stay matched forever if neither tap coord (Open-all 960,965 / per-item Confirm 959,960) hits the right spot for an unseen 3rd layout — timeout only fires on the ABSENT path, so a stuck MATCH has no built-in exit. This bounded chain caps it at 6 total dual-taps before giving up and moving on to mystery_box_reveal rather than looping forever.

mb_reveal_retry_3._note: Reveal retry chain (escape hatch): mysterybox_marker can theoretically stay matched forever if neither tap coord (Open-all 960,965 / per-item Confirm 959,960) hits the right spot for an unseen 3rd layout — timeout only fires on the ABSENT path, so a stuck MATCH has no built-in exit. This bounded chain caps it at 6 total dual-taps before giving up and moving on to mystery_box_reveal rather than looping forever.

This bounded chain caps it at 6 total dual-taps before giving up and moving on to mystery_box_reveal rather than looping forever.

This bounded chain caps it at 6 total dual-taps before giving up and moving on to mystery_box_reveal rather than looping forever.

mb_reveal_retry_6._note: Reveal retry chain (escape hatch): mysterybox_marker can theoretically stay matched forever if neither tap coord (Open-all 960,965 / per-item Confirm 959,960) hits the right spot for an unseen 3rd layout — timeout only fires on the ABSENT path, so a stuck MATCH has no built-in exit. This bounded chain caps it at 6 total dual-taps before giving up and moving on to mystery_box_recheck rather than looping forever.

verify_no_sendlife._note: Second Play-tap gate. A 'Send <name> a free Life?' dialog can sit ON TOP of home (or the boost shop) while Play! still scores 1.00 through it, same class of bug as the inactive-popup gate. Present -> Cancel (727,688 — gray/left, NEVER Confirm 1189,687) -> back to home to re-check. Absent -> no popup at all -> run the real Play tap (original verify_no_popup.on_absent body, unchanged).

probe_settings._note: User can manually open Game Settings (gear icon, top-right of home) at any time, on any tab (Options/Notifications/Performance/Game Info) -- no marker recognized this screen before, so the bot sat frozen matching nothing. Detect the teal 'Game Settings' title ribbon (shared by all 4 tabs); close via X (1671,145) -> home re-checks. Absent -> continue the normal chain.

probe_fortunebakery._note: 'Fortune Bakery' popup (fortune-cookie dough picker) can sit over home, covering Play!, with no auto-buy risk on our side (we never tap Select Dough). Detected by the teal 'Fortune Bakery' banner (fortunebakery_marker.png). Close via X (1633,301 — scaled from a 1217x703 screenshot ratio, NOT yet CV-verified live; re-crop/re-measure on first live catch if the tap misses). Absent -> probe_prevresults (chain unchanged).

probe_speed._note: SPEED GUARD: run must be played with +17% base speed equipped. speedbase17_banner.png ('+17% base speed' pill) shows on the shop's right panel whenever equipped (CV: present=1.000, absent ~0.33-0.38). Present -> check_heart. Absent after retries -> buy_speed. Ported from boxrun_ep3's probe_speed, wired into the ep6 box-farm skeleton (play-to-death, no early quit except the box-quit gate below).

buy_speed._note: No +17% speed equipped (probe_speed confirmed pill absent). The shop opens on the HP-Upgrade view where no Multi toggle exists (confirmed live 2026-07-29 — buy_speed's old single-tap at 1649,337 landed on the 'Buy some Boosts!' grid instead, never opening the picker, and start_run looped retry_buy forever burning coins). FIRST tap the Random Boost slot (810,875 — the mystery-box '?' tile, bottom-right of the boost grid) to switch the right panel to Random Boost, THEN tap the pink Multi toggle (1645,340) to open the picker. +17% base speed opens ALREADY TICKED (only checked row) so do NOT tap any boost row. Hand to picker. Ported from boxrun_ep6's buy_magnet — same shop layout, only the target boost differs.

check_box._note: Once per 4-hop cycle: did we pick up a Mystery Box this run? The '[?] xN' counter appears top-left (boxcounter_marker at a fixed 118,360) the instant a box is collected and stays there for the rest of the run — so checking once per cycle can't miss it, it just bounds the reaction to one cycle. Present -> the run has served its only purpose (box farming), so quit_run bails out immediately instead of running to death, turning a ~4-5 min run into ~40s. Absent -> no box yet, keep running via check_shop_after_run. Counter self=1.000, no-box in-run=0.345 — clean separation.

quit_run._note: Box collected -> bail out via the pause menu to bank it now. Sequence (coords CV-verified live): pause button (1790,55) -> pause menu 'Quit' (960,640) -> confirm dialog 'Quit' (960,570, NOT Cancel at 960,755). Quitting drops straight to the Result popup with the box credited (Consumed Life is spent either way, so quitting loses nothing a full run would have kept). Hand to run_result -> the existing Mystery Box open/reveal chain banks it. Waits are generous (1200-1500ms) because each tap triggers a menu/dialog fade the next tap must land after.
